title: Winamp 2.91 (full)
note: Nullsoft Winamp 2.91 full installer, from the last 2.x line that runs on Windows 95. Plays MP3, WAV, MIDI, CD audio and SHOUTcast streams; skins are compatible with classic 2.x skins. Version identified by the archive filename (the installer is compressed).

title: Windows Media Player 6.4 (6.4.05.0803)
note: Original Windows Media Player 6.4 setup for Windows 95/98/NT 4. Setup refuses to run without Internet Explorer 4.0 or later; IE 4.01 SP2 is in the Browsers section. Newer WMP 7+ releases do not support Windows 95.

title: Windows Media Player 6.4 later build (6.4.07.1110)
note: Later 6.4 component setup carrying updated DirectShow files. Its license names Windows 95 and 98, but the archive filename suggests a Windows 98 release; if it will not install, use the 6.4.05 build above.

title: Windows Media Player 6.4 security update (KB828026)
note: Microsoft update 6.4.7.1128 replacing msdxm.ocx for Windows Media Player 6.4 (MS04-005 era). Install after Media Player 6.4.

title: Windows Media 8 codecs for Media Player 6.4
note: Codec pack 8.0.0.4487 adding Windows Media Audio/Video 8 and MPEG-4 decoders so Media Player 6.4 can play later WMA and WMV files.
